author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Short Interest Update
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was the recipient of a large growth in short interest in the month of November. As of November 15th, there was short interest totalling 41,791,371 shares, a growth of 14.6% from the October 31st total of 36,469,092 shares. Based on an average daily volume of 49,659,457 shares, the short-interest ratio is currently 0.8 days. Currently, 0.9% of the shares of the company are sold short.
AAPL stock opened at $180.94 on Thursday. Apple has a 52-week low of $150.24 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The company has a market cap of $858.28 billion, a PE ratio of 15.19, a PEG ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.26.
